g.text: HURDLE & CARRY · TEST 2: VARY THE CARRY REDUCTION
Lower carry increases or preserves LP value under fixed investment performance.
Additional LP NPV per $100 committed. Illustrative inputs: 20% asset growth,15% discount rate, 1.35% fee and workbook timing. No hurdle assumed to isolate carry.
Baseline: 20% carry and nohurdle, with the investmentinputs held fixed.
The zero-hurdle assumptionis an analytical control, nota proposal to give up existingprotection.
Five points means 20% → 15%,not a 5% relative cut; the15% row is Q5's test point.
Zero carry gives the model's greatest LP value. The model does not establish a feasible negotiated optimum.

Source: Inputs!C13:L14, C19:C23; the team's Q5 sensitivity analysis (reproduced lower-carry waterfall). Under the no-hurdle control, eligible profits and timing stayfixed, so gains are proportional to the carry reduction. Cross-check: 15% carry $2.36 × 7.5 ≈ $17.67m (Q5 Analysis!E10). Unrounded outputs are scaled on slide 43.
